suggestions.quote: Fact: in a 2023 study, people who suspected their chat partner was using AI-suggested replies judged them more harshly, even though actually using them made the chats closer and kinder; the use never hurt anyone, the suspicion did (c22).

keep.quote: The one number: this country was once called the texting capital of the world (c01); by 2008, over a billion texts a day (c02).
Fact within two lines: in a study this year, people told a personal message was written by AI called the sender lazy and insincere; told nothing, most never suspected (c20).
Fact: one security company estimated that in 2024 bots, good and bad, passed people at fifty-one per cent of web traffic, for the first time in a decade (c09).
